Headline results — run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (stride 20), from `python3 ~/poro/agent/report.py`:

RECORDS & ANOMALIES
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20), covering 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z (3.314% of the time window)
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc)

INJECTION / EXTRACTION (15.96 days)
- Injected: 4.654e+05 m3; extracted: 5.059e+05 m3; net -4.048e+04 m3 (net negative, i.e. slight net extraction)

CATALOGUE (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016)
- 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07

CALIBRATED PROBABILITIES (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — this is the calibrated estimate, using the LBNL catalogue):
- b = 1.0:  Sigma = -5.449,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198,  P(M>=5.5) over observed volume = 5.236e-06,  P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922,   P(M>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0002155,  P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281,  P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474,    P(M>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0006484,  P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at or above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts — this is the upper bound, NOT calibrated):
- b = 0.9849, Sigma = -2.698, P(M>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842

INTERPRETATION: The calibrated (LBNL-catalogue) annual probability of a Pohang-like Mw >= 5.5 event ranges from ~1.2e-4 (b=1.0) to ~1.5e-2 (b=0.65) per year, with Sigma strongly negative (-5.3 to -5.4), indicating no evidence of injection-induced seismicity at Brady Hot Springs in March 2016. The DAS-based figure (P = 0.078/yr) is an upper bound only, because DAS magnitudes are uncalibrated and all 62 detections are counted as events at/above Mc, so it over-counts; it should not be read as a calibrated hazard estimate.
